info.title: Tarka Control API
info.description: Organization-scoped provisioning, credentials, policy, usage, storage, Hosted Git, and sandbox management.

tags.name: ProvisioningService
tags.description:
ProvisioningService manages Tarka identities, organizations, API keys,
quotas, metering, object storage, hosted Git, and desired-state compute
resources.

tags.name: SandboxService
tags.description:
SandboxService exposes deliberately narrow code execution. It does not
accept container images, commands, ports, mounts, shell sessions, browsers,
or persistent volumes.

get.summary:
ListAgentHostTemplates returns the versioned Compose templates published
by Tarka. Template definitions never contain runtime secret values.

post.summary:
CreateInferenceService records desired state for a managed inference
service. Reusing an organization, resource type, and name updates it.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CreateInferenceServiceRequest defines desired state for an inference service.

get.summary:
ListLocations returns the locations where Tarka can place sandboxes,
Agent Hosts and storage buckets, with the products each one offers. With
an organization, preview locations that organization may use are
included.

GetCurrentUser returns the authenticated identity and its active
organization memberships.

post.summary:
BootstrapCurrentUser idempotently creates an initial organization when the
authenticated identity does not yet belong to one.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
BootstrapCurrentUserRequest customizes the first organization created for an
identity. An empty org_name lets the server derive a display name.

post.summary:
EnsureHostedGitAccess provisions or reconciles the authenticated user's
hosted Git identity.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
EnsureHostedGitAccessRequest has no parameters; identity comes from
authentication.

get.summary: ListModels returns active model aliases, optionally filtered by modality.

parameters.name: modality
parameters.description: modality is an exact modality filter; empty returns every active model.

post.summary:
AcceptOrgInvitation atomically consumes a link and creates the membership.
Retrying with the same recipient is safe and never changes an existing role.

PreviewOrgInvitation requires the verified recipient identity. Pending platform
accounts may preview and accept; invitations never grant product entitlements.

CreateOrg creates an additional organization and makes the authenticated
identity its owner.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CreateOrgRequest creates an additional organization for the authenticated
identity. The caller becomes its owner.

get.summary: GetOrg returns an active organization visible to the caller.

post.summary:
StartAgentHostRegistryTest validates a complete credential assignment in a
disposable worker. It does not allocate a host or change saved credentials.
PrepareAgentHostSecrets returns a console handoff without any secret values.

get.summary: GetAgentHostSecrets returns only the handoff status and key names.

put.summary:
UploadAgentHostSecrets accepts direct authenticated file/console uploads.
This write-only method is not offered through MCP.

post.summary:
CreateAgentHost applies desired state for a managed multi-service Compose
stack or a backward-compatible single-image Agent Host.

delete.summary:
DeleteAgentHost requests deletion of an Agent Host and every namespaced
workload owned by it. Retained volume data follows the platform policy.

get.summary:
GetAgentHostConfiguration returns the editable, redacted configuration for
one Agent Host. Secret values are never returned; preserve_existing marks
secret references that may be carried into a later revision.

GetAgentHostGatewayPairing returns a short-lived pairing artifact for a
post-deploy messaging gateway. The runtime service remains private to the
Agent Host namespace and is never exposed directly to the Internet.

ListAgentHostTerminalTargets lists running application containers in this
host. Platform gateways and initialization containers are excluded.

post.summary:
CreateAgentHostTerminal opens a real interactive PTY in a selected running
container. Sessions belong to the authenticated user and this host; opening
another session never resumes a different user's shell. Requires a resource
manager role and active agents access. No command or output is audit logged.

get.summary:
ReadAgentHostTerminal reads bounded raw terminal bytes after a byte offset.
It may wait up to 20 seconds for output. Old bytes can be evicted; callers
must advance to next_offset and indicate output_lost to the user.

delete.summary:
CloseAgentHostTerminal closes only the caller's session and its exec
connection. Expired or already closed sessions are safe to close again.
Closing a terminal does not delete the host or its persistent files.

post.summary:
WriteAgentHostTerminal sends up to 16 KiB of raw input and/or a PTY resize.
Each write uses a strictly increasing input_sequence starting at 1. An exact
retry of the last write is acknowledged without replaying its input; a
reused sequence with different content or a sequence gap is rejected.

Pausing retains persistent data. Resuming explicitly reserves prepaid credit;
topping up alone never resumes a paused host.

get.summary: ListApiKeys returns redacted API-key metadata for an organization.

post.summary:
CreateApiKey creates a customer API key. Its plaintext secret is returned
exactly once in the response.
RevokeApiKey permanently disables an API key.
CreateComputeQuote returns a five-minute quote without reserving funds.

get.summary: ListGitRepositories returns hosted Git repositories in an organization.

post.summary: CreateGitRepository creates a private, LFS-enabled hosted Git repository.

delete.summary:
DeleteGitRepository deletes a hosted Git repository and records its final
state.

get.summary:
GetInferenceCapture returns this organization's optional bucket-capture
configuration and recent delivery health. It never exposes internal archives.

put.summary:
UpdateInferenceCapture enables or disables customer-owned capture for all
model calls. Requires an organization owner/admin and storage access.
Enabling idempotently provisions the organization's inference-history bucket.

post.summary:
CreateInferenceService records desired state for a managed inference
service. Reusing an organization, resource type, and name updates it.

get.summary: ListOrgInvitations returns invitation history to organization administrators.

post.summary:
CreateOrgInvitation issues a seven-day invitation or replaces a previous link.
Owners may invite admins; owners and admins may invite other non-owner roles.
The token is returned once for delivery by a trusted email client. Never log it.

CreateJob records a finite job revision and queues its first run atomically.
Exact idempotent retries return the original result. A changed revision of
an active job is rejected. An accepted response is not execution readiness.
The runtime remains feature-gated; unavailable products fail closed.

get.summary:
GetJob reads an organization-owned job's current desired state. Listing
jobs uses ListProvisionedResources with resource_type="job".

ListJobRuns returns immutable revisions, newest first. A revision may have
bounded infrastructure retries, but never overlapping execution attempts.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: page_size defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description:
page_token is opaque, at most 1024 bytes, and bound to the same
organization and job.

get.summary: GetJobRun reads execution state without returning customer output.

GetJobRunResult returns terminal result metadata and an optional signed log
download. It rechecks organization and product access on every request.

post.summary:
CancelJobRun is idempotent. STOPPING retains its budget reservation until
execution is confirmed stopped. A terminal run is returned unchanged.

get.summary:
ListLocations returns the locations where Tarka can place sandboxes,
Agent Hosts and storage buckets, with the products each one offers. With
an organization, preview locations that organization may use are
included.

ListOrgMembers returns active and inactive memberships visible to an
organization member.

ListProductAccessRequests returns recent requests submitted for an
organization, optionally filtered by product.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: product optionally filters by the canonical product identifier.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit defaults to 25 and is capped at 100.

post.summary:
RequestProductAccess submits an organization-scoped request for a product
that is not yet generally self-service.

get.summary: GetQuotaPolicy returns an organization's effective inference quota policy.

put.summary: UpdateQuotaPolicy replaces an organization's inference quota policy.

get.summary:
ListProvisionedResources returns desired-state resources, optionally
filtered by resource type.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: resource_type is an exact filter; empty returns every supported type.

get.summary: GetProvisionedResource returns one desired-state resource by identifier.

ListSandboxTemplates returns built-in and organization-owned templates
visible to the caller.

post.summary:
CreateSandboxTemplate builds an immutable dependency revision and
idempotently returns the resulting template.

get.summary: GetSandboxTemplate returns a template by identifier.

delete.summary: DeleteSandboxTemplate retires a template that has no active sandboxes.

get.summary: ListSandboxes returns non-deleted sandboxes for an organization.

post.summary: CreateSandbox starts an isolated sandbox from a ready template.

get.summary: GetSandbox returns a sandbox by identifier.

delete.summary: DeleteSandbox stops and deletes a sandbox. Repeated deletion is safe.

get.summary: GetExecution returns execution status and retained output.

post.summary: Execute runs one source-code payload in a ready sandbox.

get.summary:
GetSpendLimits returns an organization's monthly spend limits and what it
has been charged against each in the current UTC calendar month.

put.summary:
UpdateSpendLimits replaces an organization's monthly spend limits. Once a
priced request could take spend past a limit that applies to it, the
Inference API refuses the request with HTTP 402 and the error code
spend_limit_reached.

get.summary: ListStorageBuckets returns object-storage buckets in an organization.

post.summary: CreateStorageBucket provisions a private, versioned S3-compatible bucket.

delete.summary: DeleteStorageBucket permanently deletes an empty object-storage bucket.

get.summary: ListStorageCredentials returns redacted credential metadata for a bucket.

post.summary:
CreateStorageCredential creates credentials scoped to one bucket. The
secret_access_key is returned exactly once in the response.
RevokeStorageCredential permanently disables a storage credential.

get.summary: GetUsagePolicy returns current allowances and an owner acceptance estimate.

post.summary: AcceptUsagePolicy enables prospective charging only after qualification.

get.summary: ListUsageEvents returns the organization's newest metered requests.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit defaults to 25 and is capped at 100.

get.summary: GetUsageSummary aggregates the organization's current UTC calendar month.

GetPricingCatalog exposes the active USD retail catalog and currency factors.
Public, read-only; never includes credentials or upstream acquisition prices.

ProvisioningServiceAcceptUsagePolicyBody.description:
AcceptUsagePolicyRequest requires the organization owner and the current
unexpired estimate. Acceptance records version, owner, time and estimate.
It never creates unpaid debt or authorizes automatic deletion of data.

ProvisioningServiceCancelJobRunBody.description: CancelJobRunRequest requires an organization owner, admin or operator.

name.description: name must be a DNS label and is unique per organization/resource type.

image.description: image is a container image reference; embedded credentials are forbidden.

container_port.description: container_port is the service port; zero selects the platform default.

max_replicas.description: max_replicas is the upper bound; zero selects the platform default.

spec.description: spec carries non-secret extension fields. Typed fields take precedence.

template_id.description:
template_id selects a versioned Tarka template such as openclaw, hermes,
or onyx. It is mutually exclusive with compose_yaml and image.

compose_yaml.description:
compose_yaml contains an inline Compose Specification document. Runtime
secret values must be supplied through variables and must not be embedded
in this document.

variables.description:
variables supplies Compose interpolation values. Secret values are
encrypted separately and never returned in ProvisionedResource.spec.

public_service.description:
public_service optionally overrides the service exposed at the stack's
generated HTTPS hostname. An x-tarka.routes extension can expose multiple
service paths without this override.

public_port.description:
public_port is required when public_service is set unless the service has
exactly one declared port.

tier.description: tier is the platform capacity profile. Empty selects the beta default.

runtime.description:
runtime configures Tarka-managed model access, runtime-specific gateway
files, and the Compose services that receive the managed environment.
It is optional for backward compatibility.

github_registry_credentials.description:
github_registry_credentials controls private ghcr.io pulls for custom Compose
only. Omission preserves the saved credentials; replacement requires both
username and token. Plaintext tokens are write-only and never echoed.

dry_run.description:
Validate and return spec.billing_quote without creating or changing a host.
The quote uses the organization billing currency; admission reserves credit at apply time.

accepted_quote_id.description: Optional for legacy EU clients; binds the normalized allocation at creation.

max_network_bytes.description:
US East Agent Hosts: combined forwarded bytes per renewable five-minute
allowance. Omitted uses 1 GiB for a new host and preserves an existing
host's allowance. Zero disables public ingress and outbound networking.
EU hosts must omit this field; their existing network policy is unchanged.

secrets_bundle_id.description:
An uploaded, unexpired bundle bound to this organization, name and revision.
Consumed atomically on apply; dry runs may reuse it without consuming it.

registry_test_id.description:
Applies a successful, unexpired pull test's complete named-credential set.
Bound to organization, host name, current credential versions and images.
Mutually exclusive with github_registry_credentials. Omission preserves
named credentials. Dry runs do not consume the test; apply consumes it once.

location.description: Placement location such as "eu-1" or "us-1" (see ListLocations). Empty selects the default location.

ProvisioningServiceCreateAgentHostBody.description:
CreateAgentHostRequest applies desired state for a complete Agent Host
Compose stack. Existing single-image callers remain supported and are
normalized into a one-service stack.

shell.description: auto selects bash when available and otherwise sh. Also accepts sh or bash.

cols.description: Terminal dimensions: 20..400 columns and 5..200 rows; zero uses 100x30.

label.description: label is an optional human-readable purpose for the credential.

allowed_model_aliases.description: Up to 128 lowercase model aliases, each containing 3 to 128 ASCII bytes. Empty uses the organization policy rather than overriding it.

scopes.description:
scopes grants product capabilities. Model scopes are "himalaya",
"inference", and "utilities"; "sandboxes" grants code-sandbox access.
Empty preserves the historical "inference" default.

ProvisioningServiceCreateApiKeyBody.description: CreateApiKeyRequest creates an organization-scoped customer credential.

product.description: product is agents, sandboxes or jobs. Availability follows the live quote.

max_runtime_seconds.description:
max_runtime_seconds bounds the reservation. An Agent Host quote covers
the next prepaid lease; renewal is separately admitted at the same rates.

max_network_bytes.description:
max_network_bytes bounds combined forwarded upload and download bytes.
US East omission defaults to 1 GiB; explicit zero disables outbound networking.

persistent_storage_bytes.description:
US East Agent Host retained disk allocation. Compose dry-runs derive this from
the actual volumes. Other products and EU quotes leave this at zero.

ProvisioningServiceCreateComputeQuoteBod.description:
CreateComputeQuoteRequest prices normalized resource allocation in the
organization's billing currency. It does not reserve funds or create work.
An omitted location uses the product default from ListLocations. Existing
resources retain their location; accepting a quote never moves them.

name.description: name is the URL-safe repository name within the organization.

initialize.description: initialize creates the first commit when true.

default_branch.description:
default_branch is used when initialize is true; empty selects the platform
default.

ProvisioningServiceCreateGitRepositoryBo.description: CreateGitRepositoryRequest defines a private hosted Git repository.

name.description: name must be a DNS label and is unique per organization/resource type.

model_alias.description: model_alias must refer to an active entry returned by ListModels.

min_replicas.description: min_replicas is the non-negative lower autoscaling bound.

max_replicas.description:
max_replicas is the non-negative upper autoscaling bound; zero means the
platform default.

spec.description: spec carries non-secret extension fields. Typed fields take precedence.

ProvisioningServiceCreateInferenceServic.description: CreateInferenceServiceRequest defines desired state for an inference service.

name.description: name must be a DNS label and is unique per organization/resource type.

image.description: image is a container image reference; embedded credentials are forbidden.

command.description: command is the argv executed in the container without shell expansion.

timeout_seconds.description: timeout_seconds is the execution limit; zero selects the platform default.

spec.description: spec carries non-secret extension fields. Typed fields take precedence.

location.description:
location is a hard constraint. Omission selects eu-1. US East requires explicit
us-1 and accepted_quote_id; there is no automatic US East fallback. The selected
location is immutable and returned on the resource and run.

resources.description: resources has platform defaults when omitted; zero fields select defaults.

retry_policy.description: retry_policy defaults to one On-Demand attempt with no automatic retries.

idempotency_key.description:
idempotency_key safely retries creation for 24 hours. Reusing a key with
changed content is rejected. A new key creates a new immutable revision
only after the previous run is terminal.

queue_timeout_seconds.description:
queue_timeout_seconds bounds capacity wait, independently of execution.
Zero selects 600 seconds; explicit values must be between 30 and 3600.

accepted_quote_id.description: Required for us-1; must match the request and be unexpired.

max_network_bytes.description: Omission defaults to 1 GiB for US East; zero disables networking.

ProvisioningServiceCreateJobBody.description: CreateJobRequest defines desired state for a finite-duration container job.

role.description: admin, operator, member, or viewer. Defaults to member.

name.description:
name is the customer-visible, URL-safe bucket name within the
organization. Tarka maps it to a globally unique physical bucket.

location.description: Placement location such as "eu-1" or "us-1" (see ListLocations). Empty selects the default location.

ProvisioningServiceCreateStorageBucketBo.description: CreateStorageBucketRequest defines a private S3-compatible bucket.

label.description: label helps operators distinguish credentials without exposing secrets.

ProvisioningServiceCreateStorageCredenti.description: CreateStorageCredentialRequest creates one access key scoped to a bucket.

ProvisioningServicePrepareAgentHostSecre.description:
PrepareAgentHostSecretsRequest starts an authenticated human/file handoff.
No secret value passes through an MCP tool. The current host revision is
captured to prevent a later application from overwriting concurrent changes.

product.description:
product is one of inference, utilities, agents, jobs, sandboxes, storage,
or git.

product_detail.description:
product_detail identifies the requested tier or product variant when one
exists, for example agent_hosts or job_runners.

ProvisioningServiceRequestProductAccessB.description:
RequestProductAccessRequest submits interest in a product that requires an
entitlement decision. The authenticated caller must be an active member of
org_id. contact_email defaults to the authenticated account email.

revoked_reason.description: revoked_reason is optional operator-visible context and contains no secret.

ProvisioningServiceRevokeApiKeyBody.description: RevokeApiKeyRequest permanently revokes one organization credential.

ProvisioningServiceStartAgentHostRegistr.description:
StartAgentHostRegistryTestRequest also supports a new host by name, before
runtime allocation or billing. Omitted credentials mean anonymous pulls.

retention_days.description: Zero retains objects until deletion; other supported values are 7, 30, 90.

ProvisioningServiceUpdateInferenceCaptur.description:
UpdateInferenceCaptureRequest replaces the organization-wide capture setting.
Disabling stops new capture and does not delete existing objects.

name.description: name is a non-empty human-readable name of at most 120 characters.

allowed_model_aliases.description: Up to 128 lowercase model aliases, each containing 3 to 128 ASCII bytes. Required when allow_all_models is false.

ProvisioningServiceUpdateQuotaPolicyBody.description: UpdateQuotaPolicyRequest replaces the organization's inference policy.

currency.description: The organization's billing currency as GetSpendLimits returns it: "usd" or "eur".

monthly_limit_microcents.description:
monthly_limit_microcents caps everything the organization is charged in a
UTC calendar month. Absent means no overall limit.

product_limits.description: At most one entry per metered product.

ProvisioningServiceUpdateSpendLimitsBody.description:
UpdateSpendLimitsRequest replaces every spend limit of an organization.
Amounts are microcents of currency: one unit is 0.00000001 of it. A limit
may be zero, which stops all priced usage it applies to, and at most
1,000,000,000,000,000 (10 million in the currency).

ProvisioningServiceUploadAgentHostSecret.description:
UploadAgentHostSecretsRequest is available over HTTPS/gRPC, never MCP.
Upload from the authenticated console or the local file helper. Values are
encrypted at rest, never returned, and cannot be replaced after upload.

cols.description: Both zero preserves the current size; otherwise the create bounds apply.

template.description: template accepts a visible template identifier or alias.

timeout_seconds.description: timeout_seconds is the sandbox lifetime within platform bounds.

idempotency_key.description:
idempotency_key safely retries this mutation for 24 hours. The same key
cannot be reused with different request content.

location.description: Placement location such as "eu-1" or "us-1". Explicit placement is fixed; omission selects eu-1.

accepted_quote_id.description: Required for us-1; optional for legacy EU clients.

resources.description: US East allocation; EU sandboxes retain their fixed 1 vCPU / 1 GiB profile.

max_network_bytes.description: US East omission defaults to 1 GiB; zero disables outbound networking.

SandboxServiceCreateSandboxBody.description: CreateCodeSandboxRequest starts a sandbox from a ready template.

alias.description: alias is an organization-scoped, URL-safe template name.

base_template_alias.description: base_template_alias selects a supported built-in Python or Node base.

idempotency_key.description:
idempotency_key safely retries this mutation for 24 hours. The same key
cannot be reused with different request content.

code.description: code is interpreted according to the sandbox template's runtime.

stdin.description: stdin is supplied verbatim to the program's standard input.

timeout_seconds.description: timeout_seconds is the execution limit within platform bounds.

idempotency_key.description:
idempotency_key safely retries this mutation for 24 hours. The same key
cannot be reused with different request content.

SandboxServiceExecuteBody.description: ExecuteRequest runs source code in an existing ready sandbox.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AdmissionAssessment.description:
AdmissionAssessment distinguishes valid input from available deployment
capacity. It reserves no capacity or funds and is not a deployment guarantee.

github_registry_access.description: github_registry_access never contains the saved token.

v1AgentHostConfiguration.description:
AgentHostConfiguration is a redacted editable snapshot of the active
revision. Secret variables have empty values and preserve_existing=true.

v1AgentHostGatewayConfiguration.description:
AgentHostGatewayConfiguration contains one runtime-specific messaging
integration. config_yaml contains non-secret advanced settings. Credentials
are supplied separately through variables and encrypted at rest.

v1AgentHostGatewayDefinition.description:
AgentHostGatewayDefinition describes one gateway option rendered by the
Console. setup_mode is predeploy or postdeploy_pairing.

v1AgentHostGatewayPairing.description:
AgentHostGatewayPairing contains a short-lived artifact generated by the
private gateway runtime. data is base64-encoded by the REST gateway.

v1AgentHostGitHubRegistryAccess.description: AgentHostGitHubRegistryAccess contains only non-secret saved credential metadata.

username.description: username is the token owner's GitHub login, not the package organization.

token.description: token is a write-only classic PAT. It is encrypted before persistence.

remove.description:
remove clears saved credentials and is mutually exclusive with username/token.
The resulting Compose images must be accessible anonymously.

v1AgentHostGitHubRegistryCredentials.description:
AgentHostGitHubRegistryCredentials changes this host's ghcr.io credentials.
A classic GitHub PAT needs read:packages and access to every referenced image.

v1AgentHostRegistryCredential.description: AgentHostRegistryCredential is metadata only. A saved PAT is never returned.

services.description: Each Compose service may be assigned to at most one credential.

v1AgentHostRegistryCredentialInput.description:
AgentHostRegistryCredentialInput is a complete desired credential assignment.
An existing id/version with an omitted token preserves that saved PAT.
New/replacement PATs are accepted only through a human-controlled secret input.

status.description: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, consumed, or expired.

error_code.description: Bounded, non-secret failure code; never an upstream response body.

images.description: Successful checks return immutable image references per Compose service.

image.description:
Only canonical ghcr.io references are accepted. Images are downloaded,
verified and discarded; their entrypoints are never executed.

primary_model_alias.description:
primary_model_alias is an active chat model selected from ListModels.
When empty, a new host starts on its template's default model, or the
platform default for a stack without a template. An update keeps the
model saved in the host's latest revision, and fails if that model is no
longer available.

gateways.description: gateways contains the messaging integrations enabled for this revision.

platform_services.description:
platform_services names Compose services that receive managed runtime
configuration and non-secret TARKA_* discovery environment variables.

v1AgentHostRuntimeConfiguration.description:
AgentHostRuntimeConfiguration describes Tarka-managed configuration layered
onto a Compose stack without exposing the host-bound platform credential.

v1AgentHostRuntimeProfile.description:
AgentHostRuntimeProfile advertises immutable managed defaults for a template.
context and compaction values are enforced by the runtime adapter rather than
accepted from untrusted Compose or browser input.

status.description: status is awaiting_upload, ready, consumed or expired.

v1AgentHostSecretBundle.description:
AgentHostSecretBundle contains metadata only. The link does not authorize
access: the person opening it must authenticate and have organization access.

tier.description: tier is the default capacity profile for this template.

runtime_profile.description:
runtime_profile contains platform-owned defaults for model routing,
context management, utilities, and managed Compose services.

gateways.description: gateways lists integrations understood by this template's runtime adapter.

v1AgentHostTemplate.description: AgentHostTemplate describes a versioned, platform-tested Compose stack.

v1AgentHostTemplateVariable.description:
AgentHostTemplateVariable documents one configurable template value without
exposing a runtime secret.

v1AgentHostTerminal.description:
AgentHostTerminal contains no reusable infrastructure credential. The opaque
ID is usable only with the same authenticated user, organization, and host.
Sessions expire after 15 minutes without input or one hour in total; the
broker can also terminate a session during restart or after 64 MiB of output.

error_code.description:
Stable, non-secret reason such as shell_unavailable, session_expired,
output_limit, or connection_closed. An empty value indicates normal exit.

v1AgentHostTerminalOutput.description:
AgentHostTerminalOutput contains at most 64 KiB of raw PTY output. REST bytes
are base64 encoded; clients must not interpret output as HTML or log it.

v1AgentHostTerminalTarget.description:
AgentHostTerminalTarget identifies one currently running application container.
Names are informational, not authority to access arbitrary Kubernetes pods.

preserve_existing.description:
preserve_existing reuses the encrypted value from the active revision.
It is valid only for secret variables during an update and is returned by
GetAgentHostConfiguration when an encrypted value already exists.

v1AgentHostVariable.description:
AgentHostVariable is one Compose interpolation value. Values marked secret
are accepted once over TLS, encrypted at rest, mounted from Kubernetes
Secrets, and redacted from all read responses.

user_id.description: user_id identifies the identity that created the credential.

kind.description: kind distinguishes customer and future managed credential classes.

key_prefix.description: key_prefix is safe to display and cannot authenticate a request.

v1ApiKey.description: ApiKey is redacted metadata for a customer credential.

org_name.description: org_name is the initial organization's human-readable name.

v1BootstrapCurrentUserRequest.description:
BootstrapCurrentUserRequest customizes the first organization created for an
identity. An empty org_name lets the server derive a display name.

timeout_seconds.description: timeout_seconds is the requested maximum sandbox lifetime.

expires_at.description:
expires_at is the enforced sandbox lifetime deadline. Queued admission
leaves it unset until readiness; then it is ready_at + timeout_seconds.

failure_code.description: failure_code is a stable machine-readable lifecycle failure code.

location.description: location is where the sandbox runs, such as "eu-1" or "us-1".

queue_deadline.description:
queue_deadline bounds the capacity/setup wait, default ten minutes.
Expiry fails the request and releases its unused reservation.

v1CodeSandbox.description: CodeSandbox is an isolated, time-bounded execution environment.

v1CodeSandboxStatus.description:
CodeSandboxStatus is the lifecycle of an isolated sandbox instance.

 - CODE_SANDBOX_STATUS_QUEUED: Capacity has been reserved but the runtime is not ready. Queue/setup time
does not consume the requested sandbox lifetime or incur compute usage.

available.description: available=false is an estimate only; it cannot authorize creation.

allocated_memory_bytes.description: Exact Agent Host allocation; resources.memory_mib rounds up for display.

persistent_storage_bytes.description:
US East Agent Host disks remain allocated and metered while paused. Charges
begin after allocation, stop after deletion, and never authorize debt or
automatic deletion. Existing EU data usage policy remains separate.

startup_reservation_microcents.description:
Initial temporary hold while a node/image starts. Unexecuted runtime is
not billed. Once ready, maximum_reservation_microcents covers each lease.

admission.description: Advisory admission snapshot; creation rechecks capacity atomically.

v1ComputeQuote.description:
ComputeQuote is immutable and expires five minutes after issuance. Amounts
use the named currency's microcents (100,000,000 = one currency unit).
Acceptance on creation binds org, product, location, resources and limits.
A changed catalog, currency, expired quote or changed allocation needs a new
quote. Legacy EU clients may omit acceptance; US East callers must supply it.

plaintext_key.description: plaintext_key is returned only at creation and cannot be recovered later.

v1CreateApiKeyResponse.description: CreateApiKeyResponse contains metadata plus the one-time plaintext secret.

name.description: name must be a DNS label and is unique per organization/resource type.

model_alias.description: model_alias must refer to an active entry returned by ListModels.

min_replicas.description: min_replicas is the non-negative lower autoscaling bound.

max_replicas.description:
max_replicas is the non-negative upper autoscaling bound; zero means the
platform default.

spec.description: spec carries non-secret extension fields. Typed fields take precedence.

v1CreateInferenceServiceRequest.description: CreateInferenceServiceRequest defines desired state for an inference service.

token.description: One-time delivery secret. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

name.description: name is a non-empty human-readable name of at most 120 characters.

slug.description:
slug is an optional immutable URL-safe identifier. When empty, the server
allocates one from the name. Explicit slugs must be globally unique.

v1CreateOrgRequest.description:
CreateOrgRequest creates an additional organization for the authenticated
identity. The caller becomes its owner.

v1CreateStorageCredentialResponse.description:
CreateStorageCredentialResponse includes the plaintext credential once.
Tarka does not persist secret_access_key and cannot return it again.

user_id.description: user_id is the stable platform identity identifier.

email.description: email is the identity's current email address, when available.

orgs.description: orgs contains active organizations in membership creation order.

default_org_id.description: default_org_id is the first active organization, or empty when none exists.

entitlements.description:
entitlements contains the caller's current server-authoritative product
access decisions. API keys never grant access beyond these decisions.

v1CurrentUser.description:
CurrentUser is the authenticated platform identity and its active
organization memberships.

v1EnsureHostedGitAccessRequest.description:
EnsureHostedGitAccessRequest has no parameters; identity comes from
authentication.

stdout.description: stdout is empty after its retention deadline.

stderr.description: stderr is empty after its retention deadline.

output_truncated.description: output_truncated indicates that stdout or stderr exceeded platform limits.

error_code.description: error_code is a stable machine-readable platform/runtime failure code.

output_expires_at.description:
output_expires_at is the output retention deadline. Execution metadata
remains available after output expires.

v1Execution.description: Execution is one source-code run and its retained output.

v1ExecutionStatus.description: ExecutionStatus is the terminal or in-progress state of one execution.

status.description: status is the repository lifecycle/reconciliation state.

lfs_enabled.description: lfs_enabled is true when Git LFS support is enforced.

v1GitRepository.description: GitRepository describes a private Tarka-hosted Git repository.

status.description: status is the reconciliation state of hosted Git access.

forgejo_username.description: forgejo_username is the stable username on Tarka's hosted Git service.

web_url.description: web_url opens the hosted Git user interface.

v1HostedGitAccess.description: HostedGitAccess describes the caller's hosted Git identity.

last_error_code.description: A fixed diagnostic code; never includes payload content or storage secrets.

v1InferenceCapture.description:
InferenceCapture describes customer-controlled S3 delivery, independent of
Responses store:true and free Himalaya's Tarka-owned evaluation archive.

cpu_millis.description: cpu_millis defaults to 1000; explicit values are 250..6000.

memory_mib.description: memory_mib defaults to 1024; explicit values are 128..32768.

ephemeral_storage_mib.description: ephemeral_storage_mib defaults to 1024; explicit values are 512..32768.

v1JobResources.description:
JobResources bounds a single execution attempt. Zero selects the documented
default. The preview supports up to 6 vCPUs, 32 GiB RAM and 32 GiB scratch.
Memory and scratch are independent; scratch is ephemeral and not a volume.

max_attempts.description:
max_attempts includes the first attempt. Zero selects one; 2..3 require
retryable=true. Each attempt has its own execution timeout and usage.

allow_spot.description:
allow_spot requires retryable=true and max_attempts>=2. Unqualified Spot
capacity is rejected; this flag never silently weakens isolation.

v1JobRetryPolicy.description:
JobRetryPolicy is explicit consent to possible repeated external effects.
Only qualified infrastructure interruptions can retry, after confirmed
termination of the old attempt. Exit failures and timeouts are not retried.
Queue redelivery and lease expiry alone never authorize another attempt.

image_digest.description: image_digest is the immutable image selected at admission.

attempt.description:
attempt is zero before the first claim and increases only after old work
has been confirmed stopped. At most one attempt may execute at a time.

started_at.description: started_at is unset until execution actually starts; setup time is free.

failure_code.description: failure_code is a stable bounded machine code, never customer logs.

exit_code.description: exit_code is present only when the runtime observed an exit status.

v1JobRun.description: JobRun is execution metadata, not a queue message or a credential container.

logs_url.description:
logs_url is an HTTPS download of bounded combined stdout/stderr. It is
empty if logs are unavailable or have expired, and is valid for <=5 minutes.

v1JobRunResult.description:
JobRunResult retains terminal metadata after the logs' seven-day retention.
Signed URLs are temporary bearer capabilities; clients must not publish them.

v1JobRunStatus.description: JobRunStatus describes a single immutable revision and its bounded attempts.

v1ListGitRepositoriesResponse.description: ListGitRepositoriesResponse contains hosted Git repository metadata.

v1ListJobRunsResponse.description: ListJobRunsResponse contains a bounded page of execution history.

v1ListLocationsResponse.description: ListLocationsResponse lists placement locations, default first.

v1ListModelsResponse.description: ListModelsResponse contains the active model catalog.

v1ListOrgMembersResponse.description: ListOrgMembersResponse contains memberships in creation order.

v1ListProvisionedResourcesResponse.description:
ListProvisionedResourcesResponse contains desired-state resources in
newest-first order.

v1ListSandboxesResponse.description: ListSandboxesResponse contains non-deleted sandboxes in newest-first order.

v1ListUsageEventsResponse.description: ListUsageEventsResponse contains records in newest-first order.

id.description: id is the stable identifier, such as "eu-1" or "us-1".

display_name.description: display_name is a human-readable name, such as "Europe (Germany)".

country_code.description: country_code is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where workloads run.

is_default.description: is_default is true for the location used when a request omits location.

products.description:
products lists enabled placement products: "sandboxes", "agent_hosts",
"jobs" and "object_storage". A listed location does not by itself grant
product access or promise immediately available capacity.

status.description:
status is "available", or "preview" when only admitted organizations may
place resources here.

capabilities.description:
Product-specific placement policy. Legacy resources may remain operable
even when accepting_new_resources is false. No field grants entitlement.

country_verified.description: False means the country has not yet been verified against provider inventory.

v1Location.description:
Location is a place where Tarka runs customer workloads and stores data.
Identifiers are stable and provider-neutral: a location keeps its id if the
hardware or provider behind it changes.

reason.description: Stable, non-secret explanation when new placement is unavailable.

id.description: id is the immutable model-registry identifier.

model_alias.description: model_alias is the stable customer-facing identifier used in requests.

display_name.description: display_name is a human-readable model name.

modality.description: modality classifies the model's input/output family.

status.description: status is the catalog lifecycle state.

provider_slug.description: provider_slug identifies the upstream provider, when applicable.

upstream_model.description: upstream_model is the provider's model identifier, when applicable.

context_window.description: context_window is the maximum supported token context, when known.

price_input_microcents_per_million.description:
price_input_microcents_per_million is the input-token price. One
microcent is USD 0.00000001.

price_output_microcents_per_million.description:
price_output_microcents_per_million is the output-token price. One
microcent is USD 0.00000001.

capabilities.description: capabilities contains model-specific, non-secret feature metadata.

access_product.description:
access_product is the server-authoritative API-key scope and user
entitlement required to use this model: himalaya, inference, or utilities.

v1Model.description: Model describes a stable Tarka model alias and its metering metadata.

id.description: id is the immutable organization identifier.

slug.description: slug is the immutable URL-safe organization name.

name.description: name is the mutable human-readable organization name.

status.description: status is the organization's lifecycle state.

role.description: role is the caller's role in this organization.

created_at.description: created_at is the organization creation time.

v1Org.description: Org is an organization as visible to the authenticated caller.

v1OrgInvitation.description: OrgInvitation excludes the secret token and reports expiry as a status.

v1OrgMember.description:
OrgMember describes one identity's access to an organization. Email is
included so organization members can identify collaborators in the console.

v1PricingCatalog.description:
PricingCatalog is versioned. All monetary integers are USD microcents,
with explicit denominators for tokens, seconds and compute periods.

status.description: status is draft, submitted, approved, live, or declined.

v1ProductAccessRequest.description: ProductAccessRequest is the durable status of one product-access request.

product.description:
product is a canonical identifier such as "himalaya", "inference",
"utilities", "agents", "jobs", "sandboxes", "storage", or "git".

status.description:
status is pending, approved, expired, suspended, or revoked. Expired is
an effective status returned when an otherwise-approved grant is past its
optional expires_at timestamp.

approved_at.description: approved_at is populated when status is approved.

expires_at.description:
expires_at is the optional instant after which this grant stops
authorizing requests. The server enforces it on every request.

v1ProductEntitlement.description: ProductEntitlement describes one user-level product access decision.

product.description: product is a product identifier from the product-access catalog.

metered.description:
metered is true when the product's usage is charged and its limits are
enforced. A product that is not metered cannot take a limit yet.

monthly_limit_microcents.description:
monthly_limit_microcents is absent when the product has no limit of its
own and draws on the overall limit only.

spent_microcents.description:
spent_microcents is what the product has been charged since
period_start.

v1ProductSpend.description: ProductSpend is one product's spend limit and what it has been charged.

product.description: Product identifier from the product-access catalog.

monthly_limit_microcents.description:
monthly_limit_microcents is required. A product limit sent without one
fails with spend_limit_amount_required rather than reading as zero.

v1ProductSpendLimit.description: ProductSpendLimit caps one product's charges in a UTC calendar month.

resource_type.description:
resource_type is a stable machine-readable type such as
"inference_service", "agent", or "job".

status.description: status is the lifecycle state reported by the platform.

namespace.description: namespace is the backing workload namespace, once assigned.

external_url.description: external_url is the public workload URL, once assigned.

spec.description: spec is the normalized desired state and contains no credentials.

status_detail.description: status_detail contains non-secret provider/controller status metadata.

location.description: location is where the resource runs, such as "eu-1" or "us-1".

latest_run_id.description: latest_run_id is populated for jobs; use GetJobRun for execution state.

admission.description: Present on validation previews; this is not a capacity reservation.

v1ProvisionedResource.description:
ProvisionedResource is the recorded desired and observed state for a managed
resource.

v1QuotaPolicy.description: QuotaPolicy is the effective inference policy for an organization.

v1RevokeApiKeyResponse.description: RevokeApiKeyResponse contains the credential's final metadata.

v1SandboxRuntime.description:
SandboxRuntime is a supported source-code runtime family.

 - SANDBOX_RUNTIME_UNSPECIFIED: SANDBOX_RUNTIME_UNSPECIFIED is invalid for creation.

id.description: id is the immutable template identifier.

org_id.description: org_id is empty for a platform built-in template.

alias.description: alias is the stable organization-scoped or built-in template name.

runtime_version.description: runtime_version is the resolved interpreter/runtime version.

base_template_alias.description: base_template_alias identifies the built-in base used for this template.

dependency_file_type.description: dependency_file_type identifies the selected dependency manifest format.

dependency_manifest_sha256.description: dependency_manifest_sha256 is the normalized manifest digest.

image_digest.description: image_digest is the immutable built image digest once ready.

build_error_code.description: build_error_code is a stable machine-readable failure code.

v1SandboxTemplate.description: SandboxTemplate is a reusable runtime plus an immutable dependency revision.

v1SandboxTemplateStatus.description: SandboxTemplateStatus is the lifecycle of a reusable sandbox template.

currency.description:
currency is the organization's billing currency, "usd" or "eur": that of
its live billing account, otherwise "usd".

monthly_limit_microcents.description: monthly_limit_microcents is absent when there is no overall limit.

spent_microcents.description:
spent_microcents is what priced usage has been charged since
period_start, across every product.

products.description:
products lists every product whose usage is charged or can be, each
with its own limit and spend.

period_end.description: period_end is exclusive. Spend counts from zero again from then.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the limits last changed. Absent if never set.

as_of.description: as_of is when the spend in this message was measured.

held_microcents.description:
held_microcents is what priced calls in flight have reserved: the most
each can cost. It counts against the limits, on top of spent_microcents,
until those calls finish and are charged what they really cost.

v1SpendLimits.description:
SpendLimits is an organization's monthly spend limits and what it has been
charged in the current UTC calendar month. Every amount is in microcents of
currency: one unit is 0.00000001 of it.

name.description: name is the customer-visible name, unique within the organization.

status.description: status is the bucket lifecycle/reconciliation state.

endpoint.description: endpoint is the public S3-compatible API endpoint.

region.description:
region is the S3 signing region to configure in S3 clients. It is not
the Tarka location; see location.

s3_bucket_name.description:
s3_bucket_name is the globally unique bucket identifier to send to S3
data-plane clients. name remains the organization-local display name.

location.description:
location is the Tarka location that stores the bucket, such as "eu-1"
or "us-1".

v1StorageBucket.description: StorageBucket describes a private Tarka-managed S3-compatible bucket.

access_key_prefix.description: access_key_prefix is safe to display and identify in the console.

v1StorageCredential.description: StorageCredential is redacted metadata for a bucket-scoped S3 access key.

meter.description: meter is retained_bytes, volume_bytes, build_seconds or download_bytes.

unit_quantity.description: unit_quantity and period_seconds describe the rate denominator.

v1UsageAllowance.description:
UsageAllowance combines retained data continuously; time/transfer allowances
reset at the UTC month boundary with no rollover. Grants are account-level
and assigned to one organization, never multiplied by additional owners.

request_id.description: request_id correlates the event with the originating request.

model.description: model is the customer-facing Tarka alias.

error_code.description: error_code is empty for a successful request.

cost_microcents.description: cost_microcents uses true microcents: one unit is USD 0.00000001.

billed_currency.description: Actual ledger amount, in billed_currency microcents, fixed at admission.

v1UsageEvent.description: UsageEvent is one metered inference request.

mode.description: mode is shadow, awaiting_acceptance, active, read_only or meter_stale.

charging_ready.description:
charging_ready follows the completed shadow-meter gate; acceptance is
rejected until all backend enforcement and meters are qualified.

v1UsagePolicy.description:
UsagePolicy is a quote for explicit owner acceptance of storage, Git,
build, volume and EU download usage charging. Existing data is never billed
before acceptance; stale inventory cannot authorize new paid growth.

cost_microcents.description: cost_microcents uses true microcents: one unit is USD 0.00000001.

v1UsageSummary.description: UsageSummary aggregates metering over a half-open UTC time interval.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer Tarka account access token. Sandbox RPCs also accept a tk_live_ key with the sandboxes scope.
bearerAuth.name: Authorization
